title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Named, documented destinations on nearby York Boulevard, Eagle Rock Boulevard, Colorado Boulevard, Griffin Avenue, and Avenue 58 corridors.

cards.title: OXY ARTS — community exhibitions
cards.subtitle: York Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition before heading over; exhibitions, events, and programming are free and open to the public unless noted otherwise.
cards.short_summary: Occidental’s community-based arts hub at 4757 York Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: OXY ARTS lists its address as 4757 York Boulevard and states that its events and programming are free and open to the public unless otherwise indicated.
cards.access_notes: Gallery hours are Tuesday–Saturday, 11 a.m.–4 p.m., when exhibitions are on view; closed Sundays and national holidays.

cards.title: Bob Baker Marionette Theater — marionette performances
cards.subtitle: York Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Look at the theater’s calendar and plan around a listed performance; its York Boulevard home presents shows with handcrafted marionettes.
cards.short_summary: A theater whose collection includes more than 3,000 handcrafted marionettes.
cards.evidence_claim: Bob Baker Marionette Theater identifies its location as 4949 York Boulevard and says its collection includes more than 3,000 handcrafted marionettes.
cards.source_title: Planning Your Visit — Bob Baker Marionette Theater
cards.access_notes: Review the theater’s calendar and ticket information before visiting.

cards.title: Arroyo Records — browse vinyl
cards.subtitle: York Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Set aside time to flip through the record bins; the college identifies Arroyo Records as an independent store carrying music across genres.
cards.short_summary: An independent record-store stop at 5123½ York Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental College lists Arroyo Records at 5123½ York Boulevard and describes it as an indie record store offering music in many genres.
cards.source_title: Eagle Rock & Highland Park | Occidental College
cards.access_notes: Retail purchases are optional; confirm current store hours directly before going.

cards.title: Galco’s Soda Pop Stop — soda and candy shelves
cards.subtitle: York Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Browse the nonalcoholic soda and candy selection, then decide whether to buy; Oxy identifies this as a family-owned soda, candy, and deli stop.
cards.short_summary: A family-owned soda, candy, and Italian-deli destination at 5702 York Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental College lists Galco’s Soda Pop Stop at 5702 York Boulevard as a family-owned soda and candy stop with an Italian deli.
cards.source_title: Eagle Rock & Highland Park | Occidental College
cards.access_notes: Purchases are optional; verify current hours with the business before visiting.

cards.title: York Boulevard Park — daylight outdoor pause
cards.subtitle: York Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Use this small city park for a daylight break along York Boulevard; plan to leave before dusk, the posted closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Los Angeles Recreation and Parks site at 4948 York Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: Los Angeles Recreation and Parks lists York Boulevard Park at 4948 York Boulevard with daily dawn-to-dusk hours.
cards.source_title: York Boulevard Park | City of Los Angeles Department of Recreation and Parks
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are daily from dawn to dusk.

cards.title: Vidiots — video-store browsing
cards.subtitle: Eagle Rock Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Browse the video store or choose a calendar-listed screening; check the title rating and ticket details before committing to a show.
cards.short_summary: A nonprofit video store and theater at 4884 Eagle Rock Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: Vidiots lists its location at 4884 Eagle Rock Boulevard and distinguishes video-store hours from daily movie screenings.
cards.access_notes: Video store hours: Mon–Wed noon–10 p.m.; Thu–Fri noon–11 p.m.; Sat 11 a.m.–11 p.m.; Sun 11 a.m.–10 p.m. Screening times vary.

cards.title: Creature’s Plants and Coffee — nursery browsing
cards.subtitle: Eagle Rock Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Walk through the plant nursery and coffee-shop space; use the address to confirm you are at the Eagle Rock Boulevard location.
cards.short_summary: A full-scale plant nursery and coffee shop at 4958 North Eagle Rock Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental College lists Creature’s Plants and Coffee at 4958 North Eagle Rock Boulevard and describes it as a full-scale plant nursery and coffee shop.
cards.source_title: Eagle Rock & Highland Park | Occidental College
cards.access_notes: Purchases are optional; verify current business hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Center for the Arts Eagle Rock
cards.title: Center for the Arts Eagle Rock — historic-library arts hub
cards.subtitle: Colorado Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Check the center’s public program calendar before visiting; the site occupies a historic Carnegie library building on Colorado Boulevard.
cards.short_summary: A City cultural center housed in a historic Carnegie library building.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Los Angeles identifies Center for the Arts Eagle Rock at 2225 Colorado Boulevard, housed in a historic Carnegie library building.
cards.source_title: Center for the Arts Eagle Rock | Department of Cultural Affairs
cards.access_notes: Consult the center’s calendar for program-specific access and admission details.

cards.title: Audubon Center at Debs Park — native-habitat learning
cards.subtitle: Griffin Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Start at the center and use its educational material to orient a nature visit; the organization emphasizes habitat restoration and stewardship.
cards.short_summary: An Audubon community hub at 4700 North Griffin Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Audubon lists the center at 4700 North Griffin Avenue and says it brings people together to restore native habitats and inspire environmental stewardship.
cards.source_title: Audubon Center at Debs Park | Audubon
cards.access_notes: Check Audubon’s current visitor and program information before traveling to the center.

cards.title: Highland Park Station — A Line connection
cards.subtitle: Avenue 58 corridor
cards.notes: Use this station when planning a rail connection to Union Station; verify current service notices and fares with LA Metro before departure.
cards.short_summary: An A Line station at 203 North Avenue 58.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental College lists Highland Park Metro Station at 203 North Avenue 58 and states that the A Line connects to Union Station in downtown Los Angeles.
cards.source_title: Eagle Rock & Highland Park | Occidental College
cards.access_notes: Transit service and fares vary; consult LA Metro for current trip details.
